# Artificial Civilization Laboratory (ACL)

> The Artificial Civilization Laboratory (ACL) is an artificial civilization simulation that tests whether civilization and intelligence can emerge from nature alone. An independent research project: open code and records, preregistered experiments, and a book. Built by Abdurashid Khudoyberdiev. An agent-based world of hunter-gatherers: no list of inventions, no reward for inventing, no language models.

- [ACL](https://abu4evere.github.io/artificial-civilization-laboratory/): the mission and the film
- [Code and every experiment record](https://github.com/abu4evere/artificial-civilization-laboratory) (public; all rights reserved)
- [The book: The World That Nobody Wrote, Part One](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HNVKRLFL)
